title: Investment Banking Analyst
summary: Investment banking analysts help companies buy or sell businesses (M&A) and raise money through share or bond issues. They sit at the bottom of a deal team, building financial models, valuations, pitch books and investor documents for associates and directors.
dailyDuties: Build and update financial and valuation models for live deals
Prepare pitch books and client presentations
Draft teasers and information memoranda for investors
Track due diligence requests and maintain the data room
Pull comparable company and transaction data
Join client, lawyer and auditor calls and record action points

skills.expectation: Build and update operating, merger and DCF models for live deals and pitches
Value companies with trading comparables, transaction comparables and DCF
Prepare pitch books and client presentations for M&A and fund-raising mandates
Support buy-side and sell-side M&A deals from mandate to closing
Work on equity and debt raises such as IPOs, QIPs and bond or NCD issues
Draft teasers and information memoranda for investors and buyers
Set up the data room and track due diligence requests and answers
Read company financials and annual reports and spread the numbers
Work fast and accurately in Excel, the main tool for models
Write clear deal materials and present work to senior bankers
Know the basics of SEBI ICDR rules for IPO and QIP documents
Pull comparables and deal data from Capital IQ, Bloomberg or similar
Research a sector to support a pitch or a buyer list
Coordinate with clients, lawyers, auditors and other advisers on a deal
